create_sweep: create a hyperparameter sweep that maps a key to a list of candidate values
chain_sweeps: chain multiple hyperparameter sweeps together into a single sequential sweep
zip_sweeps: zip multiple hyperparameter sweeps of equal length into combined override dicts
product_sweeps: compute the cartesian product of multiple hyperparameter sweeps for grid search
generate_log_uniform_values: generate log-uniform random values between two bounds for hyperparameter tuning
